items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I knew him as one would know a co-worker, a close co-worker, which was pretty good.

ctx.x: Did you know Fletcher very well?

How well? I don't know how to answer. I knew him as one would know a co-worker, a close co-worker, which was pretty good. There was always respect and he was always very kind. He was the elder statesman at that point. Benny had built his band around Fletcher's arrangements and I was suppose to imitate that, I think, but I never really could. Maybe Fletcher respected me because I didn't; I don't know.
I imagine he did. Did you get to hear Fletcher's band in its heyday?
